newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-OTC MARKET VOLUME IN MARCH 7.45 MLN LATS.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-OTC MARKET VOLUME IN MARCH 7.45 MLN LATS.

text.p: Riga stock exchange said on Monday that the over-the-counter market registered volume of 7.45 million lats in March versus 3.34 million on the official market.
Most of the OTC market belonged to leading bank Unibanka on 4.73 million lats.
Fellow official list stock Riga Transport Fleet had 1.02 million lats or 599,652 shares while secondary list shares Valmiera Glassfibre maker and Daugavpils Chain factory followed far behind.
Valmiera registered 603,303 lats of volume or 288,814 shares and Daugavpils had 587,776 million lats or 238,238 shares traded on the free market.
Among other shares active on the OTC market in March were Kaija fish cannery and Riga Agricultural machine factory.
Kaija, which is soon to join the official list, saw free trade of 246,449 last or 111,931 shares.
Agricultural Machine factory traded 100,000 lats or 500,924 shares on the free market.
